statement: Conditional on true OUTSIDE_GENE primary-intergenic MOP occurrences, the fraction lying within 100 bp of an annotated gene boundary will exceed the genome-matched valid-intergenic 16-nt background fraction.
support_condition: observed/expected >1 and one-sided 20,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before calculating gene-boundary distances for any of the 884 observed primary-intergenic MOP occurrences.
